case_number: Civil Appeal No. 8510 of 2022 (arising out of S.L.P. (Civil) No. 19277 of 2018)

parties.respondent: The Divisional Manager, United India Insurance Co. Ltd. and Anr.

summary: The appellant, Sidram, suffered grievous injuries including 45% permanent disability and paraplegia in a motor vehicle accident caused by rash and negligent driving on 18.07.2012. The Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal (MACT), Belgaum, initially awarded Rs. 6,13,000/- in compensation. The Karnataka High Court enhanced it to Rs. 9,26,800/- by revising the monthly income to Rs. 7,000/- and awarding additional compensation for loss of earnings and litigation expenses, while disallowing future medical expenses due to lack of proof. The appellant challenged the adequacy of compensation before the Supreme Court, arguing for higher income assumption (Rs. 9,000/-), inclusion of future medical expenses (Rs. 2,50,000/-) based on medical evidence, enhanced conveyance, marriage prospects, and attendant charges. The High Court's calculation under loss of future earnings and denial of future medical expenses were contested.
legal_provisions_cited: Master Ayush v. Branch Manager, Reliance General Insurance Company Limited and Another, (2022) 7 SCC 738
Sanjay Kumar v. Ashok Kumar and Another, (2014) 5 SCC 330
final_judgment: The appeal was pending consideration; no final order on enhancement was pronounced in the provided text.
